question: In December 2021, who became the 3rd fastest Indian fast bowler to pick up 200 Test wickets?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mohammed Shami**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mohammed Shami **achieved a remarkable feat by becoming the **11th Indian bowler** to secure **200 wickets in Test cricket,** accomplishing this milestone in **just 55 test matches**.
 
• Notably, he is only the **5th Indian pace bowler** to achieve this milestone in the purest form of the game.
 
• Shami's achievement places him as the third-fastest Indian pace bowler to reach the 200-wicket mark in Test cricket.
 
• He follows in the footsteps of legendary players **Kapil Dev and Javagal Srinath, **who achieved this milestone in 50 and 54 Tests respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Ishant Sharma**, a versatile Indian cricketer, has showcased his skills in Test, ODI, and T20I formats. His notable achievement came in February 2021 during a series against England, where he clinched his 300th wicket in Test cricket.
 
• **Jasprit Bumrah**, another key player for the Indian cricket team, excels across all formats. He holds the title of the fastest Indian pacer to reach 150 wickets in Test cricket. He stands as the second fastest Indian bowler to claim 100 wickets in One-Day International cricket.
 
• **Bhuvneshwar Kumar** is a former Indian international cricketer who represented the Indian cricket team from 2012 to 2022.
